import math

# Current device location (San Francisco, CA)
lat1, lon1 = 37.7749, -122.4194

# Haversine formula

dlat = math.radians(lat2 - lat1)
dlon = math.radians(lon2 - lon1)

print(f'  {distance_km:,.1f} km')
print(f'')
print(f'Estimated driving distance (typically ~15-30% longer):')

"
